column1: # Book values corrected from first principles (id<TAB>exact value).
# Read by tools/gr/build_table.py (--value-fix).  A G&R value printed as a
# decimal approximation is not a closed form: the table serves the exact value
# below, or (without an entry here) leaves the formula out.  Each value was
# checked against the book's decimal and against NIntegrate at 30 digits.
# 3.486: Int_0^1 x^-x dx = Sum_{n>=1} n^-n (Johann Bernoulli 1697): expand
#   x^-x = Sum_k (-x Log x)^k/k! and use Int_0^1 x^k Log[x]^k dx = (-1)^k k!/(k+1)^(k+1).
#   = Sum_k (-1)^k (q^(3k+1) + q^(3k+2)); Int_0^oo x E^(-a x) dx = 1/a^2 gives
#   = -(EulerGamma + Log[k+1])/(k+1), so the value is -EulerGamma Log[2] - eta'(1)
#   with eta'(1) = EulerGamma Log[2] - Log[2]^2/2: the EulerGamma terms cancel.
